notes: Sixth Lever tenant. Board carries the tenant's 'Costa Rica' location filter in job_board_url, so expected_unfiltered_count=1 equals expected_jobs — the URL baseline IS the filtered view (unfiltered board is 13). Derived prefix /oowlish needs no override. This is the doola/REAP shape rather than the Smarsh one: Oowlish postings are multi-location and the board exposes two competing in-region options, 'Costa Rica' (1 posting) and 'San Jose, San Jose, Costa Rica' (2 postings), so Case B's preference rule has something to re-pick and hooks.filter_already_applied would not hold. Observed directly: without pre_filter_urls the agent cleared the filter on 1 of 3 runs and returned the full 13-posting board; with pre_filter_urls, 4 of 4 match. Note that 3 postings list Costa Rica in Lever's allLocations, but the exact-match ?location= filter surfaces only the 1 whose string is literally 'Costa Rica'.
